Metadata.title: Zarrin Namaye Caspian | Official Hisense Distributor in Iran
Metadata.description: Zarrin Namaye Caspian is the official Hisense distributor in Iran, supplying Hisense TVs, air conditioners, refrigerators and washing machines with the official warranty and a nationwide sales and service network.

tvHisense.title: Hisense TVs: Mini-LED, QLED and ULED models
tvHisense.description: The Hisense TVs Zarrin Namaye Caspian supplies with the official warranty, from bright Mini-LED to QLED and ULED for every room and budget.

rac.title: Hisense air conditioners: wall-mounted, inverter and floor-standing
rac.description: Hisense split units installed and serviced by Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s authorized representatives, with efficient, quiet cooling for every Iranian climate.

video.title: A Hisense air conditioner at work
video.description: Air is directed toward the ceiling when cooling and toward the floor when heating; see the smart louvres and temperature display up close before you buy.
video.label: Short clip of a Hisense split air conditioner running in cooling and heating modes

cac.title: Hisense ducted splits and commercial air conditioning
cac.description: Hisense ducted systems for office, retail and industrial buildings, with technical consultation and project support from Zarrin Namaye Caspian.

refrigerator.title: Hisense refrigerators: side-by-side, combi and chest freezers
refrigerator.description: Hisense refrigerators and freezers in a range of capacities and sizes, supplied with the official warranty and after-sales service by Zarrin Namaye Caspian.

washingMachine.title: Hisense 8 kg washing machines
washingMachine.description: The Hisense 8010 and 8012 with a broad choice of wash programs, backed by the official warranty and Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s nationwide service.

about.title: Zarrin Namaye Caspian Industries
about.description: The official Hisense distributor in Iran since 2009, with a network of more than 1,300 sales and service representatives nationwide.

contact.title: Contact Zarrin Namaye Caspian
contact.description: Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s Tehran head office and regional teams can help with purchases, installation, service and trade partnerships.

hisenseRepair.title: Hisense repair and servicing
hisenseRepair.description: Book a repair or service for your Hisense TV, air conditioner or home appliance, handled by Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s authorized representatives with genuine parts.

complaint.title: Submit and track a customer complaint
complaint.description: Report a complaint or suggestion about a product or service; Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s customer relations team reviews and follows it up.

survey.title: Customer satisfaction survey
survey.description: Take a few minutes to tell Zarrin Namaye Caspian about your purchase and after-sales service experience.

faq.title: Hisense air conditioner and TV questions answered
faq.description: Guidance on split AC installation, copper piping, gas charging, TV mounting, warranty and repairs for Hisense products, from Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s specialists.

warranty.title: Hisense warranty at Zarrin Namaye Caspian
warranty.description: Warranty and guarantee coverage for Hisense products supplied by Zarrin Namaye Caspian, exclusions, after-sales service, and the warranty terms PDF.

portal.title: Zarrin Namaye Caspian service representatives portal
portal.description: Sign-in for Zarrin Namaye Caspian’s authorized after-sales service representatives to the official Hisense service portal.

findServiceCenter.title: Authorized after-sales service representatives

requestRepresentation.title: Become a Zarrin Namaye Caspian sales or service representative
